title: Unused and undeclared packages; TypeScript strict mode off
steps: depcheck 1.4.7 on both packages, each candidate verified by source search.
expected: Every declared dependency is used and every import is declared; strict typing enabled.
actual: Unused (no source reference): backend @aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner, chapa-nodejs, express-validator, rate-limit-redis; frontend @hello-pangea/dnd, @hookform/resolvers, @radix-ui/react-toast, @stripe/react-stripe-js, @stripe/stripe-js, canvas-confetti, zod. Imported but only installed transitively: @radix-ui/react-collapsible. strict is false in backend and unset in frontend; 43 explicit any in backend, 244 in frontend; only 2 ts-ignore/expect-error.
impact: Larger install and audit surface (unused Stripe JS also keeps js.stripe.com in the CSP); a transitive-only import can break on an unrelated upgrade.
fix: Remove the unused packages, add @radix-ui/react-collapsible explicitly, drop js.stripe.com from the CSP if Stripe Elements is unused, and enable strict per-directory (start with lib/ and routes/).
